name: My Pure Boyfriend
source:
"Do you really believe…that a girl will fall in love with you?"

Several months have passed since I've started working the school and being called "The Tamer of Love." I am still in training. The masochistic charming pure students love me for some reason.

I lecture them from day-to-day, but my hobby is… romance games or "Otome games". I have no interest in real life men, whatsoever. Because none of them can beat the 2D world no matter how good looking or wealthy they are. However… That does not mean I was always like this from the start. I'm just tired of having relationships with real life men. Learning to let go is sometimes important.

Yes, since that day. Because that was the reason why I started working at the academy.
